instruction.text: In some situations, it is more appropriate to speak formally. Would you expect to hear formal or informal English in this situation?

trainers.hint:
Formal English is more polite and is usually used with strangers and older people.

Informal English is more relaxed and is usually used with friends and family.

atoms.a: Playing with your friends at the park.
Playing a game with your family.

feedback.end: When speaking formally, you should always use Standard English. When speaking informally, you might often use non-standard English.

instruction.text: Is this sentence standard or non-Standard English?

feedback.correct: This is an example of Standard English. It follows correct grammatical rules and is considered to be the official way of writing or speaking.
This is an example of non-Standard English. It does not follow correct grammatical rules and often includes examples of slang.

instruction.text: Drag the sentences to the correct group.

atoms.b: You was playing football with me.
Would you like to watch a film?
